title: 第77章:阴魂巡村，符锁枯棺

第77章:阴魂巡村，符锁枯棺-《道士下山之749局》

哒哒、哒哒。

脚步声不急不缓，从幽深村道尽头缓缓传来。

空旷死寂的村落里，这一道单调沉闷的脚步声显得格外突兀，每一声都像踩在人心尖上，压迫得人呼吸发紧。

灰蒙蒙的天色之下，整条村道雾气氤氲，灰黑色煞气缓缓流动，视线被雾气遮挡，前方十米之外，一片模糊。

众人迅速结成阵型。

胡九郎立于最前，身位居中，负责推演阵法、锁定阴邪方位；范梦雪右侧护法，雷法蓄势待发；王欣欣、茉沫左侧压阵，暗器全部上弦；李安琪殿后，金石灵气铺展地面，随时构筑防御；钱丹袖中蛊虫苏醒，幽绿虫光若隐若现；杨瑞手持法牌，随时加固护身结界；林佳冷静观察，记录煞气波动；李二牛掐着仙家口诀，浑身灵光隐隐闪烁。

九人阵型严丝合缝，毫无破绽。

“不是阴兵。”胡九郎低声开口，目光穿透重重灰雾，“是被阵法操控的散魂，生前皆是本村村民，死后魂魄不得轮回，被困此地，沦为阵中傀儡。”

说话之间，雾气深处，缓缓走出一道人影。

那人穿着破旧泛黄的老式棉袄，身形佝偻，头发花白散乱，脑袋死死低垂，看不清面容，双臂僵硬垂在身侧，步伐机械沉重，一步一顿，顺着村道缓缓前行。

他脚下没有影子，周身缠绕淡淡的灰雾，寒气刺骨。

明明走在冻土之上，却没有半点脚步声之外的动静，不踩草、不扬尘、不动空气，如同一道冰冷的虚影。

“是前两个月失踪的老猎户。”李二牛压低声音，语气发紧，“俺认得这件棉袄，他生前就是穿这件进山打猎，再也没回来。”

老者亡魂一路直行，对众人视而不见，僵硬走过路旁破败土墙，走向村子最深处。

而在他身后，雾气之中，接连走出第二道、第三道、第四道人影。

有弯腰驼背的老妇人，有面色木讷的壮年汉子，还有穿着破旧花袄的年幼女童。

所有人全部垂着脑袋，看不清脸，动作僵硬一致，排成一条笔直黑线，沉默前行。

一股阴冷死寂的压抑感，瞬间笼罩全队。

“东瀛阴阳师控魂术。”范梦雪眉头紧蹙，雷木法尺微微震颤，“以村落为养魂地，强行拘禁死者残魂，磨灭意识，化作巡村阴傀，用来震慑外人、守护阵眼。”

胡九郎眸光清冷，指尖铜钱凌空一抛，铜钱翻转，落在掌心，卦象暗沉发黑。

“一共七道残魂，全部被困在这片阴煞阵中。”他抬手指向村子中央，“阵眼在前方破败祠堂地下，那里煞气最重，阴气沉淀，整座村子的阴流，全部汇聚祠堂下方。”

林佳立刻记录：“祠堂？是村里早年供奉山神的旧祠堂吗？”

Ta-ta, tap-ta.

The footsteps were neither urgent nor slow, coming slowly from the end of the deep village road.

In the empty and silent village, this monotonous and dull footsteps seemed particularly abrupt. Each sound was like stepping on the top of people's hearts, making people's breathing tight.

Under the gray sky, the entire village road was covered with mist, and the gray-black evil spirit flowed slowly. The line of sight was blocked by the mist, and everything ten meters ahead was blurry.

Everyone quickly formed a formation.

Hu Jiulang stands at the front and in the middle, responsible for deducing the formation and locking the evil direction; Fan Mengxue protects the law on the right, and the thunder method is ready to go; Wang Xinxin and Momo hold the formation on the left, all hidden weapons are strung up; Li Anqi stands behind, and the golden and stone spiritual energy spreads on the ground, build defense at any time; the Gu insect in Qian Dan's sleeve awakens, and the green insect light is looming; Yang Rui holds the magic card and strengthens the protective barrier at any time; Lin Jia observes calmly and records the fluctuations of evil spirits; Li Erniu pinches the immortal mantra, and his whole body is dimly shimmering.

The nine-man formation was perfect and there were no flaws.

"They are not Yin soldiers." Hu Jiulang spoke in a low voice, his eyes piercing through the heavy gray fog, "They are scattered souls controlled by the formation. They were all villagers of this village during their lives. After death, their souls cannot reincarnate. They are trapped here and become puppets in the formation."

While speaking, a figure slowly walked out of the depths of the mist.

The man was wearing a shabby and yellowed old-fashioned cotton-padded jacket. He had a stooped figure and messy white hair. His head was hung down and his face could not be seen clearly. His arms hung stiffly at his sides. His steps were mechanical and heavy, one step at a time, and he walked slowly along the village road.

There was no shadow under his feet, a light gray mist wrapped around him, and the air was biting.

Although he was clearly walking on the frozen soil, there was no movement other than the sound of footsteps. There was no stepping on grass, no dust, and no movement of air, just like a cold shadow.

"It's the old hunter who disappeared two months ago." Li Erniu lowered his voice and tightened his tone, "I recognize this cotton-padded jacket. He wore this when he was alive and went hunting in the mountains and never came back."

The dead old man walked straight on, turning a blind eye to everyone. He stiffly walked past the dilapidated earthen wall beside the road and walked towards the deepest part of the village.

Behind him, in the mist, the second, third, and fourth figures stepped out one after another.

There are hunched old women, mature men with dull faces, and young girls wearing shabby flowered coats.

Everyone had their heads lowered, their faces could not be seen clearly, their movements were stiff and uniform, they lined up in a straight black line, and moved forward in silence.

A sense of cold, dead silence and oppression instantly enveloped the entire team.

"The Japanese Onmyoji Soul Control Technique." Fan Mengxue frowned, and the Thunder Wood Ruler trembled slightly, "Using the village as a place to raise souls, the remaining souls of the deceased are forcibly detained, their consciousness is wiped out, and they are transformed into shadow puppets that patrol the village to intimidate outsiders and protect the formation."

Hu Jiulang's eyes were cold, and he threw the copper coin in the air with his fingertips. The coin flipped over and landed in his palm, and the hexagram became dark and black.

"There are seven remnant souls in total, all trapped in this Yin evil formation." He raised his hand and pointed to the center of the village, "The formation's eye is under the ruined ancestral hall in front, where the evil energy is the strongest and the Yin energy settles. All the Yin currents in the whole village converge below the ancestral hall."

Lin Jia immediately recorded: "Ancestral hall? Is it the old ancestral hall in the village that worshiped the mountain god in the early years?"
